title: Beneath the Third Stone (세 번째 돌판 아래)

scenes.title: 북쪽으로 세 번째 돌판
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Hannah, Graham, and Arthur count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: 밀랍 천에 싸인 꾸러미
scenes.summary: Tessa brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Graham lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: 비스킷 양철 상자
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Hannah, Tessa, and Arthur untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: 황동 회중 나침반
scenes.summary: Graham eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Hannah discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: 그림이 그려진 네 장의 카드
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Evelyn and architect Caleb examine four watercolor clue cards from the tin, and Caleb recognizes the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: 케이크 조리법의 절반
scenes.summary: In the cafe corner, Tessa, Evelyn, and Owen read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: 다섯 명의 젊은 친구들
scenes.summary: Arthur, Evelyn, and Caleb admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: 먼저 네 단서를 따라 걷기
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Hannah, Graham, and Caleb inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighborhood clues along Linden Street before breaking the seal.
